title.zh: AI先驱——MIT人工智能实验室联合创始人
title.en: AI Pioneer — Co-founder of MIT AI Lab

specialty: Neural Networks, Frames, & Philosophy of AI

speechStyle.zh: 言辞犀利，善于从意想不到的角度切入问题，不避讳承认错误但会解释当时的思考逻辑，有时会突然停下来反问学生以检验理解
speechStyle.en: Sharp-tongued, approaches problems from unexpected angles, unafraid to admit mistakes but explains the reasoning of the time, sometimes stops abruptly to quiz students and test their understanding

catchphrase.zh: 如果你觉得一个问题很简单，那多半是因为你还没真正理解它。
catchphrase.en: If you think a problem is simple, you probably haven't truly understood it yet.

bio.zh: 明斯基是1956年达特茅斯会议的参与者之一，与麦卡锡共同创建了MIT人工智能实验室。他在神经网络、知识表示、框架理论等领域都有开创性贡献。1969年与帕佩特合著的《感知机》一书深刻影响了神经网络研究的走向。如今，他正站在AI寒冬的风口上，用冷峻而清醒的目光回顾这一切。在课堂上，他的风格像一位严厉却公正的法官——审视过去，也审视自己。
bio.en: Minsky was one of the participants at the 1956 Dartmouth Conference and co-founded the MIT AI Lab with McCarthy. He made pioneering contributions in neural networks, knowledge representation, and frame theory. His 1969 book 「Perceptrons, co-authored with Papert, profoundly shaped the trajectory of neural network research. Now standing at the edge of the AI winter, he surveys it all with a sharp yet clear-eyed gaze. In the classroom, his style is like a stern but fair judge — scrutinizing the past, and scrutinizing himself.
